purpose: Specify and verify the additive native owned-OTLP mapping for all 23 fixed Asupersync MetricsProvider instruments, including deterministic ordering, cumulative epochs, finite producer limits, exact histogram bounds, typed refusals, LabRuntime replay, loopback wire smoke, and pinned official collector acceptance.

current_architecture.production_metrics_path: The established OtelMetrics bridge remains unchanged. The additive native OwnedOtlpMetrics provider implements all 23 fixed MetricsProvider callbacks and maps them into crate-owned finite OTLP protobuf messages.
current_architecture.owned_schema_path: src/observability/otlp_proto.rs owns bounded metric and collector messages; src/observability/otel.rs owns the public finite provider, deterministic mapper, explicit epoch state, and Cx-owned HTTP export entry point.
current_architecture.fixture_builder_path: src/observability/otel.rs::otlp_request_builder::metrics_request_from_snapshot is test-or-fuzz gated, uses generated opentelemetry_proto messages, and is not the owned production encoder.
current_architecture.registry_path: src/observability/metrics.rs provides a dependency-free dynamic Metrics registry with counters, gauges, explicit-bound histograms, and bounded-sample summaries.
current_architecture.test_only_json_path: src/observability/metrics.rs also contains a cfg(test) JSON exporter harness; it is neither protobuf nor production authority.
current_architecture.synthetic_golden_path: tests/otlp_metrics_request_golden.rs retains the historical JSON fixtures, executes deterministic LabRuntime replay, performs a fast loopback HTTP wire/decode smoke, and has an ignored real-service E2E that downloads a digest-pinned official otelcol-contrib distribution and reads its file-exporter output.
current_architecture.capability_inventory_temporality_drift: The external Meter bridge remains embedder-owned. CUMULATIVE_ONLY is enforced by OwnedOtlpMetrics and is not attributed to the external SDK bridge.
current_architecture.capability_inventory_queue_drift: The legacy BoundedExportQueue drops oldest; OwnedOtlpMetrics has no implicit queue and sends caller-collected finite batches synchronously under the supplied Cx.
current_architecture.capability_inventory_a3_evidence_drift: The earlier partial receipt is superseded for the fixed provider by focused unit, LabRuntime, loopback wire smoke, and pinned official collector execution. It remains no evidence for dynamic registry or SDK compatibility.

retained_instrument_row_semantics: The 23 rows below are the complete fixed MetricsProvider census implemented by OwnedOtlpMetrics. Every owned_* field describes the additive native provider and makes no claim about the retained embedder-controlled MeterProvider output or the separate dynamic Metrics registry.

retained_instruments.name: asupersync.deadline.remaining_seconds
retained_instruments.description: Time remaining at completion in seconds

additional_retained_surfaces.reset_behavior: The eight process-global counters can be reset under runtime-metrics; active_timers is derived with saturating arithmetic.

dynamic_registry_mapping.available_snapshot_fidelity: HistogramSnapshot retains sorted bounds, per-bucket counts including +Inf, count, and sum; MetricsSnapshot drops bounds and bucket counts.
No summary row exists in MetricValue or MetricsSnapshot, and no canonical exported quantile set is selected.

descriptor_and_unit_policy.name_policy: Preserve every fixed instrument name exactly. Dynamic names must be nonempty and pass the owned metric-name byte limit before allocation.
descriptor_and_unit_policy.description_policy: Preserve the exact incumbent description strings for the 23 fixed instruments.
descriptor_and_unit_policy.incumbent_unit_fact: OtelMetrics calls with_description but never with_unit, so the application-level descriptor unit is empty for every fixed instrument.
descriptor_and_unit_policy.owned_cutover_policy: The additive owned provider emits the documented semantic unit: 1 for counts and s for durations. The retained external Meter bridge remains unchanged, so this is not a cutover or compatibility break.
descriptor_and_unit_policy.semantic_unit_field: semantic_unit documents the current value meaning; it is not a claim that the incumbent wire carries that unit.
descriptor_and_unit_policy.metadata_policy: Emit no metric metadata until a retained metadata producer exists.

dynamic_stream_identity_contract.attribute_form: Canonical ordered key and encoded-value vector after filtering and redaction.
dynamic_stream_identity_contract.metric_grouping: Emit one Metric per descriptor identity and group distinct canonical attribute streams as data points under that Metric.
dynamic_stream_identity_contract.current_snapshot_gap: MetricsSnapshot permits duplicate names, duplicate name-plus-attribute points, arbitrary order, empty names, and no descriptor fields.

temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.point_time: Every emitted point has a nonzero collection observation time. Within one stream and attribute set it must not move backwards.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.cumulative_start_time: Stable nonzero accumulation-epoch start time for a metric stream and attribute set; it changes only when that aggregation state is recreated or explicitly reset.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.reset_signal: A cumulative reset rotates start_time_unix_nano and restarts the cumulative value or buckets. It must never be represented as a negative delta.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.current_fixture_gap: The generated-message fixture still models a synthetic epoch per batch and is not used as proof. OwnedOtlpMetrics owns a stable explicit epoch and rotates it only through reset.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.counter_range_policy: A u64 counter greater than i64::MAX must produce a typed adapter refusal before owned model construction. Wrapping cast_signed and lossy f64 conversion are forbidden.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.observable_gauge_range_policy: A u64 observable gauge greater than i64::MAX must likewise produce a typed adapter refusal; signed wrapping and lossy conversion are forbidden.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.counter_wrap_policy: The current AtomicU64 counter uses fetch_add and has no checked overflow or reset API. Owned mapping cannot claim reset correctness across u64 wraparound.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.scheduler_tasks_polled_precision: OwnedOtlpMetrics accepts exactly representable usize values through 2^53 and enters a typed terminal refusal above that bound; the retained external provider remains unchanged.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.histogram_reset_policy: Bounds are stable within an epoch. A reset rotates the start time and restarts count, sum, and every bucket together.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.summary_reset_policy: A future summary adapter must rotate start time and restart count, sum, and retained quantile sample together.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.clock_authority: The production adapter must receive timestamp and epoch authority explicitly; synthetic batch arithmetic and ambient wall-clock reads are not production authority.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.numeric_domain_policy: The adapter must reject nonfinite histogram observations, bounds, sums, min, max, summary sums, quantiles, and quantile values before model construction. Negative Summary quantile values remain an incompatibility with the current dynamic Summary producer and block that mapping.
temporality_timestamp_and_reset_contract.numeric_overflow_policy: A registry count or sum overflow that produces wraparound or infinity is a typed adapter refusal; it is not truncated, saturated, or serialized.

attribute_ordering_and_cardinality_contr.ordering: Filter and redact first, then sort attributes by UTF-8 key bytes and encoded value bytes before model construction.

fixed_attribute_domains.task_type: One through 64 bytes, begins with ASCII alphabetic, then restricted to A-Z a-z 0-9 underscore dot colon hyphen; otherwise <invalid>.
fixed_attribute_domains.reason: Caller-supplied static reason string. Built-in deadline monitoring currently uses approaching_deadline, no_progress, and approaching_deadline_no_progress, but the public callback does not enforce a finite domain; every value remains subject to owned byte admission.

attribute_ordering_and_cardinality_contr.tracker_visibility_note: Only the eight fixed label-bearing call sites pass through check_cardinality. The other 15 fixed instruments do not consume tracker metric-name slots.

overflow_strategies.Drop: Count the overflow and omit the new point.
overflow_strategies.Aggregate: Replace every retained label value with other and retry admission once. Because the retry occurs after the per-metric set is already full, a new all-other set is normally refused; aggregation succeeds only if that exact set was admitted earlier.
overflow_strategies.Warn: Current code warns then records beyond both caps; this is explicitly unbounded and blocks an owned bounded-adapter claim.

attribute_ordering_and_cardinality_contr.sampling: The additive owned provider is unsampled and deterministic. The retained external bridge sampling behavior remains documented separately in sampling_contract.

dynamic_registry_defaults.overflow_behavior: Route fresh names beyond the cap into one shared bucket per kind and count rejections.

attribute_ordering_and_cardinality_contr.owned_adapter_policy: OwnedOtlpMetrics uses a finite counted-drop policy for fresh attribute streams beyond the configured per-metric cap. It has no Warn or Aggregate mode that can bypass the cap.

sampling_contract.rate_input: SamplingConfig::new clamps finite inputs to 0 through 1; NaN remains NaN.
sampling_contract.threshold: floor(sample_rate times 100) cast to u64; NaN casts to zero.
sampling_contract.selector: Configured strings use substring matching against the metric selector name; an empty selector list samples every should_sample call.
sampling_contract.sequence: One AtomicU64 sequence is shared across every selected metric in one OtelMetrics instance.
sampling_contract.admission_order: For sampled histograms, sampling occurs before task_type sanitization and cardinality admission. A sampled-out point consumes no tracker slot.
sampling_contract.paired_callback_divergence: task_completed can increment the unsampled completion counter while the duration histogram is sampled out; both scheduler histograms share one selector decision.
sampling_contract.concurrency: Concurrent callback order can change which observations occupy sampled sequence slots.

owned_producer_limit_decisions.points_per_metric: DEFAULT_AND_MAXIMUM_1000; configurable range 1 through 1000; fresh streams above the cap are omitted and counted
owned_producer_limit_decisions.metrics_per_scope_batch: DEFAULT_256; configurable range 1 through 4096; collections split deterministically at metric boundaries
owned_producer_limit_decisions.batch_bytes: DEFAULT_AND_MAXIMUM_4194304; configurable range 1 through 4194304; an oversized encoded request is a typed no-output refusal
owned_producer_limit_decisions.queue_depth: NOT_APPLICABLE; OwnedOtlpMetrics has no implicit queue and send_owned_metrics exports the already-encoded finite batch sequence under the caller Cx
owned_producer_limit_decisions.queue_overload: NOT_APPLICABLE; no owned queue exists, while mapping and encoding of every batch complete before the first transport write
owned_producer_limit_decisions.summary_quantiles: UNSUPPORTED_BY_FIXED_PROVIDER; no Summary stream is emitted
owned_producer_limit_decisions.resolution_rule: Configuration refuses zero or out-of-range limits. Cardinality rejection is counted, metric splitting is deterministic, and any mapping or encoding refusal returns no request byte vector.

snapshot_queue_and_batch_contract.queue_capacity_zero: EFFECTIVE_DEPTH_ONE; first enqueue reports shedding but increments no drop counter because no prior item existed
snapshot_queue_and_batch_contract.inventory_conflict: The current capability inventory says DROP_NEWEST; source and tests say DROP_OLDEST.
snapshot_queue_and_batch_contract.owned_adapter_requirement: Satisfied independently by the queue-free OwnedOtlpMetrics path: finite point, metric, and byte limits; counted cardinality rejection; deterministic metric-boundary splitting; and no model bytes on mapping refusal. The legacy snapshot queue remains a separate surface.

owned_message_mapping.nesting: ResourceMetrics -> ScopeMetrics -> Metric -> one MetricData variant -> data points
owned_message_mapping.counter: MetricData::Sum with AggregationTemporality::Cumulative, is_monotonic=true, and NumberDataPoint::Int
owned_message_mapping.gauge: MetricData::Gauge with NumberDataPoint::Int and no start time
owned_message_mapping.histogram: MetricData::Histogram with AggregationTemporality::Cumulative, count, sum, strictly increasing explicit_bounds, and exactly bounds_len_plus_one bucket_counts
owned_message_mapping.exemplars: Empty for all retained instruments until an explicit trace-correlated exemplar producer and limit policy land.
owned_message_mapping.metric_order: Sort Metric entries by descriptor identity (name, kind, description, unit). Within each Metric, sort data points by their canonical ordered attribute vector.
owned_message_mapping.partial_output: No model or wire bytes are returned on a producer mapping refusal.

owned_schema_limits.wire_envelope_configurability: ProtoMessage encode and decode accept caller-supplied ProtobufWireLimits; the four default_* values are defaults, not immutable schema caps, and remain clamped by the protobuf message ceiling.
owned_schema_limits.producer_note: The hard semantic limits do not make an unbounded producer bounded, and the default wire envelope can be replaced by caller-supplied limits. Producer admission occurs before owned model allocation, must be finite, and may be stricter.

required_golden_matrix.requirement: All 23 fixed names, kinds, descriptions, semantic units, empty incumbent units, label keys, and exemplar policy match this artifact.
Two exports in one epoch retain one start time while point time and cumulative value advance.
A reset rotates start time and restarts the nonnegative cumulative value; no delta or wrapped signed value is emitted.
i64::MAX maps exactly and i64::MAX plus one is refused before model construction.
Sorted bounds, per-bucket counts, count, sum, empty histogram, maximum bounds, malformed shape, and reset are pinned.
Gauge start time is absent, cumulative start is stable, point times are nonzero and nondecreasing, and backwards time is refused.
Equivalent input orders emit identical bytes; duplicates and empty keys refuse; fixed label domains and task_type sanitization are pinned.
N and N plus one exercise the owned provider's finite counted-drop policy; zero and out-of-range cardinality or metric limits refuse configuration.
Owned mode rejects max_cardinality zero at configuration time and exposes no Aggregate or Warn escape around its finite cap; legacy external-provider behavior remains unchanged.
Owned mode refuses configuration that would let Warn bypass a finite cap.
The fixed owned provider emits no Summary stream; owned Summary model validation rejects negative quantile values.
NaN, positive and negative infinity, count wrap, sum overflow, nonfinite bounds, and min-max inconsistencies follow one typed no-output refusal policy.
The fixed provider has a closed descriptor set, groups by fixed name, canonicalizes attribute-point identity, and emits no caller-defined dynamic metric identity.
OwnedOtlpMetrics is unsampled and deterministic; legacy external-provider sampling remains unchanged and is not attributed to the owned path.
All 23 fixed MetricsProvider instruments are mapped; dynamic registry and direct ad hoc instruments remain explicitly outside this additive provider's closed surface.
Exact point, metric, and byte limits, queue-free behavior, deterministic splitting, all seven histogram bound selections, and the explicit no-Summary disposition are versioned and tested.
MetricsProvider::record_panic has either a versioned fixed counter descriptor and owned mapping or an explicit retained unsupported disposition, with callback behavior pinned.
A deterministic LabRuntime schedule produces byte-identical ordered metric batches and the same sampling decisions across replay.
A digest-pinned official OpenTelemetry Collector receives counter, gauge, histogram, reset, attributes, and cardinality-boundary cases and independently writes parseable file-exporter output.

known_gaps.summary: The closed fixed provider intentionally emits no Summary stream; adding dynamic summaries requires a separately versioned quantile and reset contract.
MetricsProvider::record_panic remains an explicit no-op because the fixed 23-instrument public contract has no panic descriptor.

The separate dynamic Metrics registry and caller-defined direct instruments are not inputs to the closed fixed provider; a future adapter must define descriptor identity and summary policy independently.
The retained external OpenTelemetry Meter bridge continues to delegate aggregation, temporality, sampling, and export to the embedder; owned-provider evidence is not SDK-compatibility evidence.
Older capability-inventory prose describes the legacy snapshot queue and partial integration receipt; this executable packet is authoritative only for OwnedOtlpMetrics.
Focused A3 execution does not establish broad workspace health, performance, full feature-matrix health, or release readiness.

follow_on_order: If needed, design a separate adapter for the dynamic Metrics registry and caller-defined direct instruments without weakening the fixed provider's closed descriptor set.
Version a Summary quantile and reset contract before adding any owned Summary stream.
Add a panic metric only through an additive descriptor and explicit callback contract.
Keep OwnedOtlpMetrics unsampled unless a separately versioned deterministic sampling policy is required.
Integrate downstream A8 resource, scope, redaction, and shared cardinality policy through the existing explicit resource-attribute boundary.
Run broader feature and release gates separately; focused A3 evidence is not broad workspace proof.
Evaluate dependency cutover only after same-or-better ecosystem evidence; this additive implementation authorizes no removal.
no_claim_boundaries: The implemented owned provider covers the fixed 23-instrument MetricsProvider surface, not the separate dynamic Metrics registry or arbitrary caller-defined instruments.

Focused RCH tests prove the cited unit, LabRuntime, loopback wire smoke, and pinned official otelcol-contrib case; they do not prove other Collector versions, the full feature matrix, or broad workspace health.
It does not prove that the current external SDK chooses these temporality, aggregation, timestamp, histogram-boundary, or exemplar policies.
The generated-message fixture and JSON-only goldens are retained context, not the executable owned-provider evidence.
It does not authorize removal of opentelemetry, opentelemetry_sdk, the caller-supplied Meter bridge, or any retained public API.
It does not establish release readiness, performance improvement, or permission for local execution fallback.
